how.sub: Four steps from an empty folder to a tracked, scored job pipeline.
how.1.title: Install
how.1.desc: One command clones career-ops and the UI, installs dependencies and opens the dashboard at 127.0.0.1:4317 — nothing runs in the cloud.
how.2.title: Scan
how.2.desc: Pull fresh postings from ~{adapters} job boards — Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, Workday and more — deduplicated into one list.
how.3.title: Evaluate
how.3.desc: AI scores each posting 0.0–5.0 against your actual CV on a six-dimension rubric, and writes a report you can audit line by line.
how.4.title: Apply & track
how.4.desc: Generate a tailored PDF or DOCX resume and a cover letter, then track statuses, responses and follow-ups in one board.
how.score.title: What the score tells you
how.score.2: apply, or start with a warm intro
features.h2: Everything a serious job search needs
features.sub: One local app instead of five subscriptions and ten browser tabs.
features.1.title: Scan ~{adapters} job boards
features.1.desc: Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Workday, hh.ru and dozens more — direct API scanning at zero cost.
features.2.title: AI fit score 0–5
features.2.desc: A six-dimension rubric scored against your actual CV, not keyword bingo. Every score ships with a written report.
features.3.title: Auto-pipeline
features.3.desc: Paste a job URL — it verifies the posting is live, evaluates it, writes the report and updates the tracker.
features.4.title: Application tracker
features.4.desc: Every application on one board with clean statuses, notes and history — stored as plain markdown you own.
features.5.title: CV Studio (PDF + DOCX)
features.5.desc: Tailor your CV to a pasted job description and export ATS-friendly PDF or DOCX in one click.
features.6.title: Cover letters
features.6.desc: Grounded in your CV and profile. Reformulated, never fabricated — no invented achievements.
features.7.title: Deep research & interview prep
features.7.desc: Company research briefs, interview prep guides and a mock-interview mode with feedback.
features.8.title: Follow-up cadence
features.8.desc: A cadence board tells you exactly which application to nudge and when — no more forgotten threads.
features.9.title: Statistics & rejection patterns
features.9.desc: Funnel analytics, target-role trends and rejection-pattern analysis — over your own data, locally.
features.10.title: {n} AI providers — or none
features.10.desc: Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Qwen, OpenRouter, GitHub Models — or a keyless copy-the-prompt mode that works with any assistant.
features.11.title: Private by design
features.11.desc: Local markdown and YAML files, a server bound to 127.0.0.1, no cloud accounts, no telemetry, no auto-submit.
features.12.title: {n} languages, RTL included
features.12.desc: The app, the full user guide and this site ship in {n} languages — including right-to-left Arabic.

open.disclaimer: Unofficial UI — not affiliated with or endorsed by career-ops / santifer.
faq.a1: Yes. The software is MIT-licensed open source — no subscription, no trial, no locked tiers. If you enable live AI features you bring your own API key and pay your provider directly, or use the keyless copy-the-prompt mode and pay nothing at all.
faq.q2: How is this different from Jobscan or Teal?
faq.a2: Those are paid cloud subscriptions that store your resume on their servers. career-ops-ui is free, open-source and runs on your machine: unlimited scans and match scores, and your CV never leaves your computer.
faq.a3: In plain markdown and YAML files in a folder you own. The server binds to 127.0.0.1, so nothing is reachable from outside your machine, and there is no telemetry.
faq.q4: Do I need an AI API key?
faq.a4: No. The keyless mode copies a ready-made prompt to your clipboard for any AI assistant you already use. Adding a key from any of the {providers} supported providers unlocks one-click live runs.
faq.q5: What do I need to install it?
faq.a5: Node.js ≥ 18 and git, on macOS, Linux or Windows (WSL). One curl command sets up everything else.
faq.a6: No — by principle. It drafts, fills and prepares; you review and press send. Nothing is ever submitted on your behalf.
faq.q7: Which job boards can it scan?
faq.a7: ~{adapters} adapters: Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Recruitee, Teamtailor, remote-work boards and Russian sources (hh.ru, Habr Career, GetMatch and more). New boards are drop-in adapter files.
faq.a8: {n}: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese (BR), Korean, Japanese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Polish, Ukrainian, Danish, Arabic (RTL), German, Italian and Turkish — including the full user guide.
faq.a9: Yes — issues, pull requests and translations are all welcome. Start with the contributing guide on GitHub.
faq.a10: No. It is an unofficial UI built on top of the open-source career-ops pipeline — not affiliated with or endorsed by career-ops / santifer.
final.h2: Your job search, on your terms
final.sub: Install it in one command. Read the code. Keep your data.
